rubric.label: Fresh, specific, material disclosure
rubric.detail: a real filing, not a rumour or a press mention.

rubric.label: Economic importance to the company
rubric.detail: is the news big relative to this company's size?

rubric.label: Volume and early price confirmation
rubric.detail: RV20 — volume against its own 20-session median.

rubric.label: Repeat-buyer or ownership cluster
rubric.detail: the same holder building, disclosure after disclosure.

rubric.label: A clear dated catalyst ahead
rubric.detail: something on the calendar, not a vague hope.

rubric.label: Already up more than 20% in five sessions
Company denies knowing why it moved
rubric.detail: told the exchange it has no explanation.

rubric.label: Severe valuation, dilution or exit risk
rubric.detail: including a float too thin to sell into.

bands.label: the research line — confirmation still required

notes: The penalties can outweigh everything. A stock can score full marks on all five positives and still fail, because the four penalties are worth more (−14) than the five positives are (+13). Most days nothing qualifies — and that is the scanner working, not failing.
Scoring rules are fixed in the research playbook and are not changed to fit a result. Nothing here is investment advice or a prediction.
